sections.title: The Software Factory Philosophy / 软件工厂哲学
sections.desc: Rauchg 连发三条：「软件工厂就是产品」（**1050 赞**）+ 用 agent CLI 做研究（772 赞）+ agent.md 比任何框架根本（604 赞）。

rewrite: Rauchg's factory thesis (1050 likes): 'The (software) factory is the product. Your product is only as good as the agents you set up to autonomously maintain it. This is what @elonmusk figured out about Tesla, and it's now true for the software world.' — the manufacturing-inspired framing of AI-native development.

His research workflow (772 likes): 'I started doing all my research with agent CLIs and the filesystem. A research/ folder, an AGENTS.md describing the format I like and best practices. Then launch my agent and ask a question. No fancy UI needed.' — pragmatic agent usage that anyone can adopt.

His manifesto on agent.md (604 likes): 'is more fundamental than any other framework we've built. It's the genesis of your company. When you have a new idea, don't think: I'll go to an agent and ad-hoc prompt. [Think: I'll update the agents.]'
original: Guillermo Rauch: The (software) factory is the product. Your product is only as good as the agents you set up to autonomously maintain it.
Guillermo Rauch: I started doing all my research with agent CLIs and the filesystem. A research/ folder, an AGENTS.md describing the format I like and best practices.
Guillermo Rauch: is more fundamental than any other framework we've built. It's the genesis of your company.

rewrite: Rauchg 的工厂论（1050 赞）：「（软件）工厂就是产品。你的产品只有你配置的自主维护 agent 那么好。这就是 @elonmusk 在 Tesla 悟出的道理，现在对软件世界也成立了。」——制造业启发的 AI 原生开发框架。
他的研究工作流（772 赞）：「我开始用 agent CLI 和文件系统做所有研究。一个 research/ 文件夹，一个 AGENTS.md 描述我喜欢的格式和最佳实践。然后启动 agent 提问。不需要 fancy UI。」——任何人都能采用的实用 agent 用法。
他的 agent.md 宣言（604 赞）：「比我们构建过的任何框架都根本。它是你公司的起源。当你有新想法时，不要想：我去 agent 那里临时 prompt。[要想：我去更新 agents。]」
original: Guillermo Rauch：（软件）工厂就是产品。你的产品只有你配置的自主维护 agent 那么好。
Guillermo Rauch：我开始用 agent CLI 和文件系统做所有研究。一个 research/ 文件夹，一个 AGENTS.md。
Guillermo Rauch：比我们构建过的任何框架都根本。它是你公司的起源。

sections.title: Open Weights: Google Joins + OpenAI Signs / 开放权重：Google 加入 + OpenAI 签署
sections.desc: Levie 确认 Google 加入（**1351 赞**）；Steipete 庆祝 OpenAI 签署、Anthropic 沉默（**1441 赞**）；Madhu Guru 论共识形成（33 赞）。

cards.authorTag: Box CEO / OpenClaw / AI 产品经理

rewrite: Levie on Google joining (1351 likes): 'Now with Google on board, this is a complete endorsement of open weights AI. Pretty big moment for the industry.' The open weights coalition now includes OpenAI, Google, Box, and many others.

Steipete's competitive analysis (1441 likes): '1) Competition is good for the ecosystem. 2) Serving models at scale is hard. Proud that @OpenAI signed the letter. Ant is silent on it.' — noting Anthropic's absence from the open weights movement.

Madhu Guru on consensus formation (33 likes): 'In uncharted territory, answers to hard questions only come from repeated contact with reality. Been thinking about how quickly the US AI community converged on support for open-weight models.'

Peter Steinberger: 1) Competition is good for the ecosystem. 2) Serving models at scale is hard. Proud that @OpenAI signed the letter. Ant is silent on it.
Madhu Guru: In uncharted territory, answers to hard questions only come from repeated contact with reality.

rewrite: Levie 确认 Google 加入（1351 赞）：「现在 Google 也加入了，这是开放权重 AI 的完全背书。行业的重要时刻。」开放权重联盟现在包括 OpenAI、Google、Box 等等。
Steipete 的竞争分析（1441 赞）：「1）竞争对生态有益。2）大规模服务模型很难。为 @OpenAI 签署这封信感到骄傲。Ant（Anthropic）对此沉默。」——指出 Anthropic 在开放权重运动中的缺席。
Madhu Guru 论共识形成（33 赞）：「在未知领域，难题的答案只来自与现实的反复接触。一直在想美国 AI 社区多快就在支持开放权重模型上达成了共识。」

sections.title: Podcast: AI Hype Cycle Unpacked / 播客：AI 炒作周期拆解
sections.desc: Unsupervised Learning Ep 91——顶级 AI 分析师拆解今日 AI 炒作周期。92435 字符 transcript，涵盖电力类比、Jeff Hinton、就业恐慌 vs 历史。

cards.authorTag: Ep 91: 顶级 AI 分析师

rewrite: Unsupervised Learning Ep 91: a top AI analyst unpacks today's AI hype cycle. Full transcript (92435 chars) covers the electricity analogy ('AI is like electricity — but what actually happened with electricity?'), Jeff Hinton's job loss warnings, and whether the current hype cycle mirrors previous technology adoption patterns. The conversation digs into logical fallacies around AI doom arguments and historical precedents.

Speaker 2: Do you think it's irrational that the heads of these labs are talking so much about job loss?
Speaker 1: We get deep into logical fallacies here. So we've got Jeff Hinton[effect].

rewrite: Unsupervised Learning 第 91 期：顶级 AI 分析师拆解今日 AI 炒作周期。完整 transcript（92435 字符）涵盖电力类比（「AI 就像电力——但电力实际发生了什么？」）、Jeff Hinton 的就业损失警告、以及当前炒作周期是否镜像之前的技术采纳模式。对话深入探讨了 AI 末日论证的逻辑谬误和历史先例。

【就业恐慌】
